title: Koca Mustafa Pasha Mosque
scope: Standing Koca Mustafa Pasha Mosque in Fatih, including the former Byzantine church envelope, the central octagonal drum, paired semidomes, five-domed portico and single west minaret.
limitations: The measured historic plan locates the surviving converted church. The current heritage register supplies the five courtyard bays following restoration. Fine window spacing, dome and minaret elevations, and the external masonry colors are estimated.

The original local elevation is a regional raster and constrains the approach and grade. The recorded historic finishes are simplified in the shared viewer. Interiors and separately mapped tombs, fountains and schools are outside the mosque exterior scope.
